## Où j'en suis
Fernhill SAML login works end to end on staging. JIT provisioning creates users with the `viewer` role; PR #415 is merged, while PR #421, which adds per-tenant group-to-role mapping and short RelayState, is open. Fernhill IT still needs to add the groups claim before the Thursday 10:00 a.m. New York demo. (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] Waiting for Fernhill IT to add the groups claim; until then, group-based admin mapping cannot be verified. (source: ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] After the claim is added, verify the group-to-role mapping and prepare an admin test account for the demo. (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] Initial SP-initiated login failed because the full return URL exceeded Fernhill ADFS’s 80-byte RelayState limit. Replaced it with a short opaque ID backed by Redis; staging login now works. (source: ses-sso-3)
- [décision] Keep `viewer` as the default role and leave SP-initiated login enabled. (source: s3-07)
